user.title: Set up MindClip
user.description: Connect one SwitchBot AI MindClip. Credentials are stored in the Home Assistant config entry and are never exposed by entities or diagnostics.

data_description.api_token: Open Token from SwitchBot Developer Options.
data_description.api_secret: Secret Key paired with the Open Token.

select_device.title: Choose a MindClip
select_device.description: Multiple AI MindClip devices are available to this SwitchBot account.

manual_device.title: Enter the MindClip device ID
manual_device.description: No AI MindClip was returned by device discovery. Enter its SwitchBot device ID manually.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate MindClip
reauth_confirm.description: SwitchBot rejected the saved credentials. Enter a valid API token and API secret for this MindClip.

data_description.api_token: Replacement Open Token from SwitchBot Developer Options.
data_description.api_secret: Replacement Secret Key paired with the Open Token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MindClip
reconfigure.description: Validate and update this MindClip configuration. The device ID must continue to identify the same physical device.

data_description.api_token: Open Token from SwitchBot Developer Options.
data_description.api_secret: Secret Key paired with the Open Token.
data_description.device_id: The existing SwitchBot device ID for this AI MindClip.

error.invalid_auth: SwitchBot rejected the API token or secret.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to SwitchBot. Try again later.
error.invalid_device: SwitchBot could not find an accessible AI MindClip with this device ID.
error.api_error: SwitchBot rejected the request. Verify the device ID and try again.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The device ID does not match this config entry. Add it as a separate MindClip instead.
